verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no first-party bulk export or open-format download. The general-purpose API ("anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI") is only a developer building block for constructing an export, and the Signals Migrator imports PagerDuty and Opsgenie config into FireHydrant rather than exporting out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
